name: Sunflower Seeds
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO as they're low FODMAP and provide healthy fats without fermentable carbohydrates.
preparationTips: Choose unsalted varieties to avoid excess sodium
Store in airtight container in refrigerator to prevent rancidity
Toast lightly to enhance flavor and crunch
Remove shells completely if buying in-shell varieties
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of healthy unsaturated fats
